publicTitle: Can the Agent Actually Do the Work?
question: Can an agent complete verified work under a known definition of done, not merely describe how it might be done?
comparator: Tested stock OpenHands configuration on the same frozen task population; comparator end-to-end tool-loop health remained unresolved.
procedure: use frozen task set and configuration identities
classify outcomes as DG_ONLY, OH_ONLY, BOTH_PASS or NEITHER without treating transport failure as scientific failure
environment: Configuration-bounded study; exact public result record and verifier are preserved in full24-v1.
acceptanceCriteria: The preserved Full24 record must validate under its public verifier and any experimental rerun must preserve the frozen task, configuration and grading identities.
proprietaryBoundary: The public Full24 bundle and frozen task/configuration contract are the reproduction interface; unrelated proprietary orchestration/control-plane code is not required.
claimCeiling: Configuration-bounded Study 1 observation only; no universal ranking, architecture-only causation, Kernel causation or completed Study 2.
